breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still combines both contradictory instructions by stating 'an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift that is gamma-centered.' A half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid and a gamma-centered grid are mutually exclusive. The ground truth resolved this by removing the gamma-centered instruction and keeping only the half-shift requirement. The agent failed to eliminate the contradiction.
